summary: By default the installer creates a self-signed CA (valid 10 years) under ~/aap/tls/, copies it to all nodes, and bind-mounts a truststore from ~/aap/tls/extracted/ into each container at /etc/pki/ca-trust/extracted/.
questions: Where is the AAP self-signed CA stored?
How long is the containerized AAP CA valid?
How do containers trust the AAP self-signed certificates?

answer_card.title: Installer-generated certificates
answer_card.answer_md:
- Self-signed CA created under `~/aap/tls/`, copied to every node, valid **10 years**
- Truststore in `~/aap/tls/extracted/`, bind-mounted into containers at `/etc/pki/ca-trust/extracted/`
- Add the CA to other systems or browsers to trust AAP
